title: Team
description: The people who work on the corpus, their role and the history of changes.

roleInfo.admin: Opens the tool and can do everything: lessons, structure, AI, statistics, marketing and team management.
roleInfo.ped: For people who write and review lessons.
roleInfo.ux: For people who work on the mobile app experience.
roleInfo.data: For people who follow statistics and learner progress.
roleInfo.learner: Mobile app account, no role in the team.

honesty.title: Only administrators can open the tool today
honesty.body: The Pedagogy, UX and Data roles are labels that show who does what. They do not give access to the tool yet.

members.title: Team members
members.selfLocked: Another administrator must change your role.
members.emptyBody: Invite someone from the team, or give a role to an account that already exists.
members.copyFailed: Could not copy the address. Select it by hand.

roleDialog.title: Change role
roleDialog.toAdmin: This person will be able to open the tool and change everything, including team roles.
roleDialog.fromAdmin: This person will no longer be able to open the tool. They keep the {{role}} label in the team.
roleDialog.toLearner: This person will no longer appear in the team. Their mobile app account does not change.
roleDialog.toLearnerFromAdmin: This person will no longer be able to open the tool and will no longer appear in the team. Their mobile app account does not change.
roleDialog.fromLearner: This person will appear in the team with the {{role}} label. They will not have access to the tool.
roleDialog.labelOnly: Only the label changes. Access to the tool stays the same: none today.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: The person receives an email to set their password.
invite.adminHint: To make someone an Administrator, invite them first, then change their role in the list.
invite.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example first.last@example.com.
invite.alreadyExists: This address probably already has an account. Find it to give it a role.
invite.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Check the address and try again.
invite.partialTitle: Invitation sent to {{email}}, but the role was not saved
invite.partialBody: The person can sign in, but does not have the {{role}} role yet. Find their account to give it to them.
invite.discardBody: The address you typed will be lost.

promote.title: Add an existing account
promote.description: Search for someone who already has an account, for example on the mobile app, to give them a role.
promote.emptyBody: Check the spelling, or invite this person if they do not have an account yet.
promote.more: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} accounts. Refine the search to find the right person.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Role changes and invitations, newest first.
activity.emptyBody: Role changes and invitations will appear here.

errors.load: The team list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.loadActivity: The activity log could not be loaded.
errors.search: The search did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
errors.missingMigration: The database is not up to date for this page. A developer needs to apply the 0008_team.sql migration.
errors.forbidden: Your account no longer has the administrator role. Reload the page.
errors.lastAdmin: Not possible: there must always be at least one administrator.
errors.unknownMember: This account no longer exists. Refresh the list.
errors.roleFailed: The role could not be changed. Try again in a moment.
